The '''Soun system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], near the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Soun IV/Legends|Soun IV]].<ref name="Inside" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Soun system in the [[Mondress sector/Legends|Mondress sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> however, this was contradicted by the maps of both the [https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region], a [[2012]] feature of the Online Companion,<ref name="Expansion">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}}</ref> and the 2012 reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', both of which placed the system in the [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|Freestanding subsectors]] area of the Expansion Region, outside the Mondress sector.<ref name="EAOC" /><ref name="TEGtW" /> Accordingly, [[Jason Fry]], author of ''The Essential Atlas'' and its Online Companion, later moved the Soun system from the Mondress sector to the Freestanding subsectors in the system appendix of the [[2025]] [[Canon]] [[Star Systems of the Galaxy]].<ref name="Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}}</ref> This article assumes the latter placement of the Soun system is correct.
